description: Land Acquisition - Munneshwaram, Chilaw D/S Division, Puttalam District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular piece of land (Lunupitiyawatta) is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and location information. While a government minister is named, this is solely in the context of issuing a statutory land acquisition declaration, not for the purpose of announcing a personnel change or detailing ministerial portfolios. The core subject matter is exclusively land-related, fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
